description: Check a domain's DNS records, DNSSEC, CAA, SPF and DMARC. $0.01 USDC on Base per call. Don't use this for DKIM, MTA-STS or BIMI; use /v1/email-auth. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
